rootCause.snapshotWriter: src/multiplayer/roomSnapshot.ts:620 createRoomSnapshot serialises game.toSave() without checking entity references.
rootCause.restoreValidator: src/multiplayer/roomSnapshot.ts:424-428 rejects a non-zero targetId that is not in the saved entity set.
rootCause.simulationCleanup: src/sim/game.ts:4959-4978 clears targetId only when order.targetId is missing; buildTargetId and repairTargetId are not cleared in this loop.
rootCause.description: A surviving entity retained a direct targetId to an entity removed by combat cleanup. The snapshot was written, but the strict restore validator correctly rejected it. The failure is state-dependent and was not a Phase 2A.11 epoch/timing failure.
